claims.evidence: PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; organismParts CL:0000182 hepatocyte; Cellosaurus site Liver. organism part=liver is derived from the cell line origin, not a tissue sample.
Paper Methods: HepG2/C3A from ATCC CRL-10741; Cellosaurus CVCL_1098.
Cellosaurus disease for CVCL_1098 is hepatoblastoma; paper/PRIDE say hepatocellular carcinoma-derived. Disease describes the cell line, applied to control rows too (untreated cells of same line).
Cellosaurus donor annotation for HepG2 lineage; not stated in paper.
Paper: 3 bioreactors treated with 5 mg APAP per mg cellular protein for 48 h, 3 control bioreactors.
Treatment/harvest at 48 h for both arms (iodoTMT-6plex and label-free derive from these bioreactors).
File names encode condition and replicate; paper: control and APAP samples analysed by label-free. Bio replicate number = number in the file name.

claims.location: TMT rows 7-42: file->biological replicate and technical replicate
claims.value: iTMT_k_R1/R2 -> bio rep k, tech rep 1/2
claims.evidence: Paper: each biological replicate analysed with duplicate injections (technical replicates), search results of the 2 technical replicates merged per biological replicate; 3 bio reps x 2 injections = 6 iTMT raw files.

claims.value: 126 control total Cys; 127 APAP total Cys; 128 control SNO; 129 APAP SNO; 130 control SOH; 131 APAP SOH
claims.evidence: Paper: ratios 127/126 (total cysteines), 129/128 (SNO), 131/130 (SOH); peptides with only APAP-treated reporter ions are '129 for SNO and 131 for SOH'. 129 and 131 explicitly APAP; 127 APAP and 126/128/130 control are inferred by parallel numerator/denominator ratio structure (no per-channel table found). PD quant method iodoTMT6_KW defines tags 126-131.
Paper Methods, PRIDE instruments, and both inspected raw headers (BMB-FUSION, Thermo Orbitrap Fusion).

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer]
claims.value: HCD; TMT 38% NCE, Orbitrap; LF 32% NCE, ion trap
claims.evidence: Raw method summary ActivationType=HCD in both; TMT: NCE 38, Orbitrap 30K MS2; LF: NCE 32, ion trap rapid (paper and header). PD TMT quantifier ActivationType filter HCD.

claims.value: iodoTMT6plex UNIMOD:1342 C Variable; Carbamidomethyl C Variable; Oxidation M Variable
claims.evidence: Mascot node DynMod_1..3 (Oxidation M, TMT6-Cys C, Carbamidomethyl C), no static mods. TMT6-Cys custom mod mass 329.226595 = iodoTMT6plex (UNIMOD:1342, formula H28 C12 13C4 N3 15N O3 in the msf).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C Fixed; Oxidation M Variable; third column 'not applicable'
claims.evidence: Mascot node of FUS02231_C_1.msf: StaticMod_1 Carbamidomethyl (C), DynMod_1 Oxidation (M). Third repeated column is padding so the file has one fixed header; no further modification was searched.
Mascot node parameters. Paper text says 20 mmu (0.02 Da) for the TMT search; deposited msf says 0.05 Da; deposited search used.
Mascot Enzyme=Trypsin, 2 missed cleavages; PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol states trypsin.
Paper: cultivated in DMEM (1 g glucose per L). Term NCIT:C185409.
HepG2/C3A obtained from ATCC cat. CRL10741.

limitations: No per-channel table for iodoTMT-6plex exists in any deposited file or the paper; 126/128/130=control and 127=APAP are inferred from ratio notation (129/131=APAP stated). Reduction chemistry per channel pair (SNO vs SOH) is from the earlier method paper (ref 13), not read.
Only 2 of 12 raw headers and 2 of 12 .msf files were read (1 iTMT, 1 label-free); other files assumed to share settings.
Whether label-free replicate k derives from the same bioreactor as iTMT experiment k is not stated, so sources are kept distinct.

Cellosaurus age/sex/disease are donor/cell-line properties, not stated in the paper. Ancestry, individual, passage, storage temperature = not available. 3D spheroid culture format is not representable in the licensed columns.
Full-text of method paper ref 13 and the paper's supplementary tables were not read.
